name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A searchable select: the panel opens, a query types itself, the list narrows, and the matching row is picked.
useWhen: Showing a searchable, filterable dropdown with a typed query narrowing the list.
Demoing autocomplete or type-ahead selection in a product walkthrough.
A form field needs a constrained set of options with search.
avoidWhen: The list is not filterable and selection is direct: use select.
The overlay is a command palette with icons and shortcuts: use command-menu.
The input is free-form text with no list: use input.
author: Remocn
